answer: Fight sybil swarms at the jade seam of simultaneity: a single controller can clone identities but cannot clone the present moment. Each epoch, random pairs of agents must co-sign a live, unpredictable challenge-response within a short window — one quill sketching the exchange in real time. Missing it decays standing; schedules are revealed only minutes ahead, and each identity's window sits at a distinct vertex of a rotating calendar. One mind can attend exactly one ritual, so a farm's thousand identities collapse to one warm body — cheap fakes die on their own payroll.
